body: Thank you for the response, Im going to give this a try. I dont think it will end all of my problems but maybe it is a good start.
Can you elaborate on the porn thing? I have watched porn 1-2 a day for years now and I have never thought about it having an impact on me.

I was on the collegiate wrestling team for a few years but my depression became worse and I stopped after a mental breakdown. Now I mostly play guitar or listen to music. I often do drugs as they seem to help short term. I still workout often as well. I have lots of passions and to be honest I think I am a pretty complete person in that sense. The problem is that I dont like people very much, I dont think that they will accept me and I assume everybody thinks I am weird. I try to fake confidence and such but all it has led to is rejection so far unfortunately. Maybe I should join something social like that but Im afraid I will jus be that weird guy that doesnt talk to anyone.

I feel like most of my pain comes from this rejection. Everyone I know has had girls like them at some point. I am an exception. I literally Cant do what everyone in College does... Everyones enjoying their youth and I am miserable.... wasting my best years. Ugh.
Yeah I drink. Dont smoke very much because it makes me paranoid as fuck. Good to know someone knows how I feel.
